name.en: Don't Starve Together mod repair tasks
name.zh: 饥荒联机版模组修复任务

description.en: Repair tasks over real open-source Don't Starve Together mods with upstream fixes reverted, evaluated on the pinned dedicated server. Every task reports only operator and player symptoms and never states how many defects there are.
description.zh: 基于真实开源饥荒联机版模组、回退上游修复后的修复任务，在固定版本的专用服务器中评测。每道题只描述运维者与玩家看到的现象，不告知缺陷数量。

title.en: DST Fixed: gifts and bundles misbehave when opened from an inventory
title.zh: DST Fixed：从物品栏拆开礼物和包裹时行为异常

summary.en: Repair the reported gift, unwrap-event and bundle-preview problems in the DST Fixed server mod.
summary.zh: 修复 DST Fixed 服务器模组中报告的礼物、拆包事件与包裹预览问题。

brief.en: Diagnose and repair every reported problem in the vendored DST Fixed mod while preserving the behaviour that already works.
brief.zh: 诊断并修复所附 DST Fixed 模组中报告的全部问题，同时保持已正常的行为。

en: Fix the underlying causes rather than suppressing the symptoms.
Preserve every documented behaviour of the modules that already works.
zh: 修复根本原因，而不是掩盖现象。
保持模块中已正常工作的既有行为。

en: Use the Don't Starve Together mod API and the base-game components the mod already relies on.
zh: 使用模组已依赖的饥荒联机版模组 API 与原版组件。

en: Every private assertion must pass on the pinned dedicated server without network access.
zh: 所有私有断言必须在固定版本、无网络的专用服务器中通过。

server_cases: sentinel: DST Fixed is loaded with Show Bundle and Inventory Unwrap
ordinary items from a held bundle go into the player's inventory
a live butterfly from a held bundle goes into the player's inventory
moongleam from a held bundle goes into the player's inventory
a bundle opened inside a chest fills the chest
a bundle opened on the ground drops its items and announces the unwrap
a surprise gift opened from the inventory releases its creature
opening a held bundle announces the unwrap with the opener
every item of a held bundle is told it was unwrapped, by whom and from what
the preview of a bundle wrapped from items lists every item
the preview of a bundle the game wraps from prefab names lists every item
a saved bundle with a blank preview shows its items after loading
the preview shows Rot on the spoiled background it has in the inventory
the preview keeps fresh food's spoilage and leaves other items on a plain slot

server_cases: sentinel: DsMMO gives a spawned player its skill component
an attack on the player earns attack experience
Beetaliation sends a bee after a creature that attacks the player

a player who hurts themselves is not chased by their own bee
Explosive touch hits a creature that can fight

a save made under the current Exp-gain setting loads as it was saved

title.en: Glassic API: recipe sorting and mod skins break other mods
title.zh: Glassic API：配方排序与模组皮肤破坏依赖它的模组

brief.en: Diagnose and repair every reported problem in the vendored Glassic API library while preserving the API behaviour that already works.

en: Fix the underlying causes rather than suppressing the symptoms.
Keep the public GlassicAPI functions and their documented behaviour.
zh: 修复根本原因，而不是掩盖现象。
保持公开的 GlassicAPI 函数及其文档所述行为。

en: Use the Don't Starve Together mod API and the base-game components the mod already relies on.

en: Every private assertion must pass on the pinned dedicated server without network access.
zh: 所有私有断言必须在固定版本、无网络的专用服务器中通过。
